description: Introducing Zal: Your PC's guardian on the go! Monitor stats, manage tasks, track temps, CPU/GPU/RAM loads, and storage health from your mobile. Customize alerts for peak performance. Your PC, your control, anywhere, anytime!

name: Zumbo
tagline: Open source local AI voice-to-text for Mac for private STT
description: Zumbo uses local AI models on your Mac to instantly turn what you say into text, with near perfect accuracy and complete privacy, in every app. About a fifth of a second from the end of your sentence to text in the app. 21 vocabulary packs, from developer tools to legal, medical and design, and it learns from your corrections: wrong once, never again. Notes with reminders, meetings with speaker labels. Works with the Wi-Fi off, no account. One-time price, open source.
